summary: Iteration 50 validated the new admin-rsvp endpoint + combined member RSVP+guests-in-one-call flow end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases passed in test_iteration50_admin_rsvp.py covering all the specified scenarios — authz (non-admin 403, anon 401), validation (missing user_id 400, unknown user_id 404, unknown event_id 404, cancelled event 400, umbrella parent event 400), happy paths (send_email:false creates inline doc with created_by_admin=admin.id, created_by_admin_name set, email_suppressed:true, 2 named guests with their own ticket_ids; send_email:true goes through shared _create_rsvp_and_email_ticket and afterwards is patched with created_by_admin attribution, email_suppressed NOT set), duplicate-RSVP 409 with 'already' message, no-email capacity 400 (cap=2 with me+2 guests=3 seats), and the member-side combined POST /events/{id}/rsvp with guests in the same payload — verified exactly ONE rsvp doc is created with the embedded guests array (length 1, name='Alex') and NO created_by_admin field on the self-service path. Frontend (Playwright): as Riley Chen (member@clubhaven.app), [data-testid=guest-manager] renders in pendingMode showing 'Add guests before you RSVP (0) · Add' plus helper text 'Bringing a +1? Add them now — you'll get one combined ticket email...'. Adding 2 guest rows (Alex, Pat) and Save updates the RSVP button to 'RSVP — me + 2 guests'. Network capture confirmed the resulting POST /api/events/{id}/rsvp body included {"guests":[{"name":"Alex",...},{"name":"Pat",...}],"ticket_type":"general"} in a single call — no follow-up PUT /rsvp/guests fired. [data-testid=admin-add-rsvp-btn] is correctly hidden for the member. As admin@clubhaven.app, the 'Admin tools' section shows [data-testid=admin-add-rsvp-btn]; clicking opens [data-testid=admin-rsvp-form] with [data-testid=admin-rsvp-member-search], [data-testid=admin-rsvp-member-list] (15 radios), [data-testid=admin-rsvp-add-guest], and [data-testid=admin-rsvp-send-email-toggle] (checked by default). Submitting (with email toggle off) succeeded — the toast 'TEST Applicant... is going! Email suppressed.' appeared, the Going list refreshed to include the new member, and re-opening the dialog dropped the picker count from 15 → 14 (the just-RSVPed member is filtered by the rsvpedIds set).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/rsvps.py:262 the admin_rsvp_event endpoint accepts `body: dict` instead of a typed Pydantic model — works but means OpenAPI/Swagger can't document the shape, and the inline `body.get('ticket_type') or 'general'` style bypasses Pydantic validation (e.g. ticket_type is never validated against the EventTicketType enum). Consider introducing an AdminRsvpIn model with optional fields {user_id, ticket_type, guests, send_email} for parity with EventRsvpIn.

routes/rsvps.py:277 admin role check uses `admin.get('role') != 'admin'` — does not respect the existing `require_admin` dependency that the rest of the codebase uses (e.g. /events/{id}/admin-rsvp could be hardened by `Depends(require_admin)` to also handle locked/disabled admin accounts consistently). Functionally equivalent today, but a drift from the project's auth convention.

routes/rsvps.py:338 capacity check on the no-email path uses `1 + len(rsvp_doc['guests'])` already includes the member seat, but the comparison `(rsvp_count + guest_count + 1 + len(guests)) > capacity` is correct. The send_email:true path goes through _create_rsvp_and_email_ticket which has the same check at line 191 (seats_needed = 1 + len(guests)). Behavior is consistent; just call out that the duplication exists in two places — a small refactor opportunity.

routes/rsvps.py:354 the attribution is patched AFTER _create_rsvp_and_email_ticket schedules the email task. There's a tiny race: the ticket email body is generated from `rsvp_doc` inside send_rsvp_ticket_email and does not include the created_by_admin field (it's only used for audit/reports), so this is safe — but worth a code comment noting that send_email:true tickets show the member as the holder, not the admin, which is the intended UX.

EventDetail.jsx:184 the rsvp-btn click handler is `onClick={() => rsvpWithGuests(pendingGuests, ...)` for the non-ticket branch (line 173 vs 182). Both paths correctly include pendingGuests — good. After successful RSVP, pendingGuests state is NOT cleared in the success handler; if the toggle-off then on flow runs, the previous pending list would re-submit. Confirmed in this test that on the toggled-on state, pendingGuests was correctly used; recommend clearing pendingGuests on rsvped:true success for safety.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 11 UI checks: guest-manager pendingMode, helper text, admin btn hidden for member, dialog open, 2 guest rows save, rsvp-btn label update, single combined POST with guests, admin btn visible for admin, admin form opens with all controls, 15 radios + filter to 14 after submit, suppressed-email toast)
